live_reference.verification: Previously verified reference supplied with task; this export does not recheck deployment.

definitions: IDs are case-sensitive and deduplicated exactly.
Every row is currently included. No title-only candidate, downloaded PDF or licensed abstract is counted as a completed read.
Review flags reproduce explicitly present record fields only. Missing flag means unrecorded, not false. Section entry count is evidence-presence, not a validated unique reading count.
Core uses current metadata_ready flag; cleared pairs require both recorded media gates cleared, with exact current bytes matched to stored hashes.
Licensed original uses abstract_display_type=original_licensed; no abstract text is exported.
Derived missing flags inspect presence/verification and do not replace historical adjudication.
Source URLs are existing record references, not newly verified URLs. URL indexes address url_prefixes.json and ordered url_entries shards.
First-page or figure files can exist while permission is on hold; existence is not clearance.
Conference-stage completion is recorded historical coverage, not independent recertification of all original per-paper decisions.
ACL Findings is an associated collection, not independently CCF A rated.
This export performs zero new scientific reading and does not publish or integrate records.
URL table uses reversible prefix encoding; reconstruct each URL exactly as specified in url_prefixes.json and ordered url_entries shards.
verified_no_institution records an explicitly verified independent researcher without an institutional affiliation; it is not a missing affiliation and contributes zero to institution statistics.
baseline_limitations: Saved-source difference, not hourly or live increment.
Core flag comparison is not like-for-like: current asset-scoped permission gate is stricter than v296.
Changed records can be metadata/material/permission updates; no new scientific-reading credit.
Only currently included records are indexed; excluded/pending historical decisions remain in the separate prior handoff ledger.

registered_stage_coverage.definition: Distinct existing progress track rows by recorded stage. Conference/edition counts are the coverage of these tracks, not claims that every track in those conferences or editions is complete.

url_reconstruction: For index i: url_prefixes[concatenated url_entries[i][0]] + concatenated url_entries[i][1].
